yt_title: Deluge If Else, ifNull and Null Checks in Zoho Explained
yt_desc:
Read the full guide: https://zudoworks.com/insights/deluge-if-else-ifnull/

Most Deluge bugs are not in the loop or the API call. They are in the if that decides whether the loop or the call runs at all. This 50-second explainer covers the rules that catch people out with conditions in Zoho Deluge: how an if, else if and else ladder picks a branch, the operator order that differs between Zoho Creator and every other Zoho service, the three functions that test for "nothing", and what to use in place of a switch statement. Every point was checked on Zoho's own Deluge and Zoho Creator help pages on 19 November 2026.

Chapters
00:00 One condition, two answers
00:03 if, else if and else: the first true test wins
00:09 Put the narrowest test first
00:13 The trap: OR and AND order in Zoho Creator
00:20 Bracket each group
00:25 isNull, isBlank and isEmpty are different tests
00:30 Testing text for null, empty text and spaces
00:36 ifNull for defaults, and a map in place of switch
00:41 The full guide

Key facts from the guide
- Deluge has if, else if and else. Each test goes in round brackets and each set of actions in curly brackets. The first test that is true runs and the rest are skipped, so order the ladder from the narrowest test to the widest.
- Zoho's logical operators page gives two orders. In Zoho Creator: NOT, then OR, then AND. In all other Zoho services: NOT, then AND, then OR. Brackets are always worked out first, so bracket each group whenever && and || share a test.
- if(test, a, b) returns one of two values in one line. ifNull(a, b) returns b when a is null; Zoho's page defines it for null only.
- isNull, isBlank and isEmpty answer different questions. In Zoho Creator, by Zoho's published table, a text of spaces is false for isNull and isEmpty but true for isBlank. Some answers differ in other Zoho services.
- For a text field, isNull(x) || isBlank(x) covers null, empty text and spaces.
- Deluge has no switch or case statement. Use an else if ladder, or a map lookup with ifNull as the default.

The guide also covers comparing text (equalsIgnoreCase, contains), the common mistakes, and a checklist to run before a condition goes live: https://zudoworks.com/insights/deluge-if-else-ifnull/

linkedin_profile:
A Deluge function can work perfectly in Zoho CRM and quietly take the wrong branch in Zoho Creator.

Same line of code. Different answer. Nothing is broken.

The reason is written on Zoho's own logical operators page, and most people never read it. When a test mixes AND and OR, Zoho Creator works out OR first. Every other Zoho service works out AND first. Zoho notes it is working on unifying the two, but until then, a test like this:

priority == "Urgent" || status == "Open" && isLate

escalates an urgent job that is not late in one product and skips it in the other.

The fix is four characters: brackets round each group. Brackets are always worked out first, in every service.

While writing our new guide to Deluge conditions, I found a few more rules worth pinning to the wall:

1. Only the first true test in an if, else if ladder runs. Put the narrowest test first, or the later branches never fire.
2. "Empty" is not one test. isNull, isBlank and isEmpty give different answers, and Zoho's own table shows some of them changing between Zoho Creator and other services.
3. For a text field, isNull(x) || isBlank(x) covers null, empty text and a field of spaces.
4. ifNull(a, b) gives a missing value a safe default before you do sums with it.
5. There is no switch statement. A map lookup with ifNull as the default does the job in two lines.

None of this is hard. It is just easy to miss until a record takes the wrong branch.

New guide: conditions and null checks in Zoho Deluge.

Where Deluge conditions go wrong:
01 Ladder order: only the first true test runs, so the narrowest goes first
02 Operator order: Zoho Creator ranks OR above AND, other Zoho services rank AND first
03 Empty values: isNull, isBlank and isEmpty are three different tests
04 Missing values: ifNull(a, b) returns b when a is null
05 No switch: an else if ladder, or a map lookup with ifNull as the default

The guide includes Zoho's published table for the three null tests, a table of which form to use when, eight common mistakes and a checklist to run before a condition goes live. Checked on Zoho's own help pages on 19 November 2026.

This matters most when a function is copied from Zoho CRM into a Zoho Creator app, or the other way round: read every mixed test again.
